object_description: three connected volumes of differentiated heights embedded in a garden setting
design_condition: Three connected volumes follow the surrounding buildings and site levels, preserve the existing garden and trees, and use inclined and stepped paths to embed the structure in the ensemble.

positive.statement: The three connected volumes enable high-quality urban development and respect the existing buildings to a high degree.

position.rationale: Three connected masses and their differentiated heights are clearly visible across all calibrated views.

positive.statement: The differentiated heights form an appropriate counterpart to neighboring buildings.

position.rationale: Stepped and varied rooflines are clearly visible, especially toward the eastern volume.

positive.statement: The facade design responds sensitively to the surroundings through differentiated articulation.

position.rationale: Facade density and articulation visibly vary along the south-east exterior.

positive.statement: The preserved and supplemented planting ties the open-space design sensitively to the existing garden.

position.rationale: Planting is not explicit in the point cloud; garden-edge open space provides the constrained anchor.

positive.statement: The clear outside-space structure continues into a clear internal organization with generously sized access areas.

position.rationale: Central connections and surrounding access zones are approximated from the connected massing.

positive.statement: The arrangement of uses ensures an optimal operational process for different user groups.

position.rationale: Operational zoning is interior; marker represents the connected building’s middle-east region.

positive.statement: The surrounding lighting of the sports hall is viewed positively.

position.rationale: Sports-hall identity is not labeled, but surrounding facade openings provide an approximate lighting anchor.

positive.statement: The stacked sports rooms enable an efficient construction method.

position.rationale: Vertically stacked upper mass is visible in the elevations.

positive.statement: The dismantling and reusability requirements are taken seriously and consistently met.

position.rationale: Circular construction intent has no distinct marker; it is assigned to the visible building envelope.

positive.statement: All rooms are naturally lit and ventilated, and the generous window proportion is viewed positively.

position.rationale: Extensive facade openings are clearly visible on the south-east elevations.

positive.statement: The project has very good construction economics.

position.rationale: Construction economics is a whole-project assessment without a spatial referent.

negative.statement: The terrain subsidence along the northeastern and northwestern facades does not yet achieve harmonious integration.

position.target: northeastern and northwestern facade terrain subsidence
position.rationale: Northern facade edges are visible, though terrain subsidence is not separately distinguishable.

negative.statement: The path to the main entrance should be more clearly highlighted and better developed as barrier-free access.

position.rationale: Entrance direction is unspecified; a front ground-level approach is used as a constrained estimate.

negative.statement: Free-standing supports in the multifunctional rooms are operationally impossible and must be rearranged.

position.rationale: Interior supports are absent from the sample; central multifunctional zone is approximated.

negative.statement: The equipment room is inconveniently located because it can only be reached through the corridor.

position.rationale: Equipment room and corridor are not identifiable; lower east-side interior surface is used.

negative.statement: The cloakroom space is generally too limited.

position.rationale: Cloakroom is likely near entry but absent from exterior geometry; front lower zone is marked.

negative.statement: The east-side main staircase should be integrated into the heated usage area for operational reasons.

position.rationale: East-side vertical circulation is directionally constrained on the visible facade edge.

negative.statement: Without summer thermal protection, glare and overheating must be checked.

position.rationale: Glare and overheating concern the exposed windowed facades; protection itself is not visible.

negative.statement: The stacked ventilation centers do not meet the standard of well-coordinated simplicity.

position.rationale: Ventilation cores are not identifiable; a central stacked vertical zone provides an estimate.

negative.statement: The hot-water storage arrangement is unfavorable for hygienic reasons and should be replaced.

position.rationale: Service equipment is absent; a lower north-east service-side surface is used as a constrained guess.
